title: gerardia fasciculata subsp. typica
intro: Gerardia fasciculata subsp. typica, commonly known as American foxglove, is a plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis, as well as its use as a diuretic and to reduce blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of American foxglove include its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its ability to alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Gerardia fasciculata subsp. typica include gerardic acid, scutellarin, and other glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
